title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East (Early Show) on 1970-02-13
taper: Thanks to Dwight Holmes for providing the cassette source
source: 5th gen aud casette from unknown source > WAV

ai_review.summary: Rough audience recording with harsh, cloudy sound and an incomplete set, but Black Peter stands out
ai_review.review: The tape is an audience capture that suffers from a harsh and cloudy mix and is missing portions of the concert, making it far less enjoyable than better‑sourced recordings. Still, reviewers note the presence of a solid Black Peter performance, offering a small musical highlight amid the technical shortcomings.

ai_rating.rationale: Only two reviews, one very negative about sound quality and another moderate; show content is average with a single highlighted song, while recording quality is poor.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Harsh, cloudy mix; incomplete recording with missing portions of the set.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Incomplete and fragmented; reviewers note it isn’t on par with fuller recordings.
